meta.note: Every quotation below was requested from the publisher and read on 2026-11-20. The URL, the page's own 'updated' date where it shows one, and the quoted wording are recorded together so a reviewer can check the quote against the source rather than against this site.
meta.rule: A quotation is reproduced exactly, including the source's own curly quotes and spacing. Where a source could not be reached, that is stated and no substitute was used.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.used_for: Section 5 (Identifying Yourself as an Associate): the required disclosure sentence.
sources.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
sources.applied_in: The disclosure strip above <main> on every page, repeated in the footer.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Program Policies
sources.used_for: Participation Requirements 2(a) and 2(b): what a Special Link is, the Associates-ID-as-parameter rule, and the price and availability rule.
sources.quote: Special Links enable accurate tracking, reporting, and accrual of commission income. Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you.
sources.quote_2: All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site. For example, you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
sources.quote_3: Because prices for and availability of Products that you have listed on your Site may change, your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
sources.applied_in: Every outbound product link is /dp/ASIN?tag=shopnow047c-20. No price, rating, review count or stock status appears anywhere.

sources.title: FTC Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.used_for: Placement of the affiliate disclosure, and why a footer-only disclosure is insufficient on its own.
sources.quote: A disclosure should be placed where it easily catches consumers’ attention and is difficult to miss.
sources.quote_2: Consumers may miss a disclosure at the bottom of a blog or page.
sources.applied_in: The strip sits under the masthead, before the article, and is repeated in the footer.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.used_for: The regulation the FTC FAQ interprets. Linked for a reviewer; not quoted here.
sources.status: linked, not independently quoted in this build

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google
sources.used_for: Confirms that rel="sponsored" is the documented marker for paid links and that rel values may be combined.
sources.quote: Mark links that are advertisements or paid placements (commonly called paid links) with the sponsored value.
sources.applied_in: rel="sponsored nofollow noopener" on every Amazon product link.

could_not_verify.item: Amazon's own definition of ASIN (10 characters, alphanumeric)
could_not_verify.reason: Rather than cite a seller-written answer as if it were Amazon's, the ten-character observation is presented as a measurement of this register's own data: every observed ASIN is 10 characters, every supplied slug is 9.

could_not_verify.item: USDA FSIS guidance on air-fryer food safety
could_not_verify.reason: No safe-internal-temperature figure appears anywhere on this site. Quoting one from a blog would give it a false provenance, so the guides avoid food-safety claims altogether (FLG-012).

could_not_verify.item: Amazon Product Advertising API / Creators API access
attempted: No credentials were supplied, and none can be created without the account owner.
could_not_verify.reason: Without API access there is no permitted way to display live price or availability, so none is displayed.

could_not_verify.item: The Associates rate card, click report and tracking-ID status
attempted: Associates Central requires an account sign-in.
could_not_verify.reason: Commission rates, click counts and conversion data are therefore absent. The ledger is empty and says why.

could_not_verify.item: Search demand for any topic on this site
attempted: No Search Console property, analytics account or keyword dataset was supplied.
could_not_verify.reason: Not one volume, difficulty or impression figure is presented. Guide topics are labelled hypotheses.
